definitions: To view something with scepticism or to not entirely believe it.
To accept something as true only with reservations and not at face value.
examples: You should take his promises with a grain of salt.
I take everything she says with a grain of salt.
Take that rumour with a grain of salt.
lemma: take with a grain of salt
synonyms: take with a pinch of salt
source: take with a grain of salt
